title: Stored warrant envelope (SPEC §5)
description: The stored form: a body plus its signatures. DERIVATIVE AND SECONDARY (see warrant-body.schema.json). This schema cannot express the part of §5 that matters — that >=1 signature MUST verify AND be by body.actor.id, that small-order and non-canonical Ed25519 public keys MUST be rejected, and that an invalid co-signature is a WARN-and-exclude rather than fatal. A structurally valid envelope here can still be an ERR under §6.

sigs.description: §5: >=1 signature MUST be present, and at least one MUST verify and carry actor == body.actor.id. Only the count is checkable here.

key.description: Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, lowercase hex. §5 additionally REQUIRES rejecting the 8 small-order torsion encodings and non-canonical y — see examples/conformance-negatives.json.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature over the 32 RAW BYTES of the WarrantID (§5). No context string, no domain separator, no pre-hash — an OPEN decision, proposals/DEC-001-domain-separation.md, nothing changed.
